title: Shalbin's Flower of Luck 16x
description: The flower made by Shalbin that grants you infinite luck for the day!
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95906e3ac5fe4c034935ddc83eecb39291c53af5.png)

### This is a resource pack that converts the Totem of Undying into the 'Candle flower', also known as 'Senna alata'.
Before I tell you all about the resource pack, you need to have some context as to why it is called "Shalbin's" flower of luck.

You see, I, Shalbin, and Legenx121212(whose real name I shall not disclose) are all studying in the same school, and we travel in the same school bus. We're close friends, and we like to sit together in the bus. Now, a few months ago, Shalbin discovered a cluster of these flowers, and he found them... rather _**'sus'**_, because of its resemblance to... uhhhhhhh.... _something_.
Now at first, we just laughed it off, until Legenx121212 renamed it to **_'flower of luck'_** from **_'sus flower'_**. Then, I added the cherry on top by putting _'Shalbin's'_ at the beginning.

we decided to give it some lore as well, because _why not._

Shalbin can summon these flowers anywhere there is suitable and 'holy' soil. Some places have 'unholy' soil, so the flowers cannot be spawned there. As a matter of fact, these flowers _were in fact just appearing out of thin air_ on random places where we had never seen them before. So... accuracy, I guess..?

If anyone tried to destroy a flower of luck, they would be cursed with infinite unluck, as every flower of luck will be a 'flower of curse' for that person. 

The flower of luck can give you infinite luck, but that multiplies with the number of them you see at once, and it will reach its maximum potential if there is the presence of Shalbin. During cold times (I think), the flowers of luck will get shorter. The shorter a flower of luck is, the less luck it gives you.

If an unworthy person tries to lift or take a flower of luck, they will get crushed under its weight and disintegrate.

So one day, Shalbin tried to cut one of these from his home and bring it to school, _but somehow_ the thing **_literally_** produced an acid-like stuff that BURNED him (slightly). So that cemented it into the position of _**BEST FLOWER IN THE WORLD**_, cuz this flower's got some _fire_ defence mechanisms.

So yeah. That's the shabin's flower of luck.

This pack is Inspired by Legenx121212's [SHALBIN'S FLOWER OF LUCK](https://modrinth.com/project/4O0v4JtU).

## Additions
- The Totem's texture has been changed to the shalbin's flower of luck.
- The Name of the Totem is also changed.
